text:
Jules (Office): @here Cozy coworking + cookie drop tomorrow 3pm in the kitchen. Tiny holiday desk plant contest too — best-dressed fern/succulent wins a prize :trophy:. Quick poll: react with :cookie: if you're coming, :evergreen_tree: if you're bringing a plant, :no_entry_sign: if you can't make it.
Aisha: :cookie: I'll be there! Bringing extra ginger snaps.
Tom: :evergreen_tree: I'm in — small succulent, adding a tiny ribbon hat.
Priya: Ooh can remote folks do a 'plants on Zoom' mini parade? :seedling:
Ben: Count me in! Also — can someone link the kitchen allergen list? I have a nut allergy. @Jules (Office)
Jules (Office): Good call. Kitchen list: `https://intranet/office/kitchen-allergens`. I'll label cookie tins and have a gluten-free option.
SantaBot: Reminder: office thermostat will be set to 68°F during event. :snowflake:
Aisha: Any dress code? Ugly scarf or festive sweater? :sweat_smile:
Priya: Let’s do 'festive desk accessory' so the plants can shine. Winner gets a tiny desktop humidifier. :tada:
Tom: Remote folks can definitely send pics to #random and we'll vote. I'm making a tiny felt hat for my succulent.
Ben: Appreciate the labeling, Jules. :heart:
Jules (Office): Plan: 3:00pm cookie drop, 3:15pm desk parade, 3:30pm casual vote. Voting via emoji on this thread. See you there!
Marta (People Ops): We'll record attendance for end-of-year happy hour RSVP. Thanks everyone!
